job.title: AI Benchmark Engineer | Native Language Specialist - German

strengths: Strong Python and shell scripting experience from full-stack web development and AI research projects
Hands-on work with multilingual NLP, trustworthiness metrics and text summarisation in Turkish, showing awareness of language-specific processing challenges
Experience designing and managing research assets, including datasets and evaluation scripts for AI models
gaps: German proficiency is elementary (A1-A2), not native or near-native as required

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Committee,

I am a computer engineer and lecturer with a PhD focus on trustworthy AI and multilingual NLP. In my recent research I built evaluation metrics for Turkish text summarisation and created LLM-as-judge pipelines, which required designing deterministic verification scripts and calibrating difficulty levels, tasks very similar to the benchmark engineering work you describe.

My software background includes full-stack development in Python, JavaScript and PHP, as well as extensive use of CLI tools for data processing and model testing. At Toros University I led a department and coordinated international projects, which gave me experience in creating high-quality assets, reviewing them, and ensuring reproducibility across teams.

Although my German is currently at an elementary level, I have lived and studied in Germany during my BSc exchange and have a solid command of English. I am comfortable learning the nuances of German grammar and encoding issues quickly, and I am ready to apply my expertise in multilingual AI to improve LILT's benchmark suite.

I look forward to discussing how my technical skills and research experience can help build robust, language-aware evaluation tasks for LILT.

Best regards,
Anıl Kuş
short_pitch: I develop AI evaluation tools and multilingual NLP pipelines, with strong Python/CLI skills and experience designing deterministic benchmarks. My research on trustworthy Turkish summarisation gives me deep insight into language-specific challenges, ready to be applied to German benchmark tasks.

answers.why_this_role: The role blends software engineering, benchmark creation and multilingual AI, exactly the mix I have worked with in my research on trustworthy NLP and evaluation metrics.
answers.why_this_organisation: LILT's focus on real-world multilingual robustness matches my goal of building AI systems that work reliably across languages and domains.
answers.relevant_experience: I built LLM-as-judge evaluation pipelines for Turkish summarisation, wrote deterministic verifier scripts, and managed data assets for AI projects in COST research networks.
answers.research_interests: My interests lie in trustworthy AI, multilingual text processing, and creating practical evaluation frameworks that expose model weaknesses.
answers.additional_information: I have co-founded a tech centre, led academic departments, and mentored students in AI, demonstrating both technical depth and project leadership.
